name: smwpatches-choose-player-smb-tll-style
title: Choose Player SMB:TLL Style
description:
This patch will disable the 2-player flag and instead loads a character based in what option you've selected at the title screen.

NEW - Changed hijack to a different area, allowing more compatibility with other patches.
Also, in SA-1 ROMs, it runs inside the chip, allowing increased speed.
Give credit if used!
